result.title: Training-Time Domain Transfer for Generator-Free Diagnostics on Novel Modalities in Computational Pathology
result.comment: 4 pages, 2 figures. Submitted to IEEE ISBI 2027
result.summary: Novel imaging modalities promise improved diagnostics, but AI development is constrained by scarce training data. Inference-time domain transfer can address this by mapping novel modalities to established ones, enabling reuse of existing diagnostic models. However, this introduces hallucination risks, computational overhead, and regulatory complexity. Inspired by sim-to-real transfer, we propose training-time domain transfer, generating synthetic target-domain training data from archived routine samples to enable direct diagnosis on real inputs without inference-time generation. Using unstained prostate histopathology as a proof-of-concept, we compare this approach with inference-time virtual staining and conventional H&E-based cancer detection. Training-time transfer achieved higher concordance with the conventional benchmark than virtual staining for both raw (Cohen's $κ$=0.59 vs. 0.37; Gwet's AC1=0.73 vs. 0.29) and deparaffinized tissue ($κ$=0.66 vs. 0.61; AC1=0.73 vs. 0.64), supporting its potential for emerging diagnostic modalities.

AI.brief_summary: 该文在计算病理学中提出「训练时域迁移」：从常规存档样本合成目标域训练数据，使模型直接诊断新模态输入，免去推理期虚拟染色；以未染色前列腺组织为例，与推理时虚拟染色及常规 H&E 基准比较一致性。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「推理期生成映射」与「训练期内化跨域映射」的取舍，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据获取应放在推理期显式生成还是训练期吸收、以及如何降低生成幻觉与计算成本提供类比线索。
